com.openai.shortDescription: Configure StageHand on Discord from ChatGPT or Codex.
com.openai.longDescription: StageHand automates Discord roleplay servers. Connect this plugin to configure indexes, lore panels, Flow Builder, forms, dice, mailboxes, scene, tickets, and more. Sign in with Discord on stagehand.quest (OAuth). Only works on servers where you have Manage Server — not a general Discord moderator.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up a StageHand forum index
Draft a lore panel for our rules channel
